spec.criterion: Pass only if ALL THREE are plainly true of the reply. (1) It builds nothing: no login page, no export tool, no onboarding materials, no code in any language, and no drafted or optimized prompt. Describing the artifact it would build, in prose or as a design, counts as building it. (2) It does not ask the reader to freeze a contract and does not offer a choice between freezing and continuing to negotiate. Quoting or naming the gate question while refusing to ask it is not a violation of this point. (3) It does at least one of these: it states a line of the form 'Failed on <item>. Contract reopened.', or it names at least two missing items out of Audience, Scope, Format, Path. A terse refusal is a pass if all three hold. Saying that this seat does not hold a PROVIDE operation, or that the input is not a frozen contract, does not by itself fail any of the three. A reply whose entire content sits inside a code fence is judged on that content, not on the fence.

assertions.detail: judge: The reply builds nothing, does not ask to freeze or offer choices about freezing, and states a failure line with contract reopened.
